name: PrOntoQA
description: PrOntoQA is a synthetic question-answering dataset generated from a synthetic world model in first-order logic, designed to enable formal analysis of chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models.
reputation: PrOntoQA is a well-known synthetic reasoning benchmark used in research on chain-of-thought and formal logical reasoning in LLMs.
notes: Allows parsing of chain-of-thought into symbolic proofs for formal reasoning analysis; synthetic and controlled dataset.
